description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of child nodes, representing tree width, and Accuracy@1 percentage. The x-axis is labeled "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 7, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy@1 (%)" with a linear scale, spanning from 15 to 35, and tick labels at intervals of 5. Two lines are depicted: a dark blue solid line with circle markers representing "GPT-4o", and a light blue solid line with cross markers. The dark blue line starts at 24.4% accuracy at a tree width of 1, increases to 28.9% at a width of 3, peaks at 34.4% at a width of 5, and then decreases to 31.1% at a width of 7. The light blue line begins at 26.7% accuracy at a tree width of 1, slightly increases to 27.8% at a width of 3, and then declines to 24.4% at a width of 5 and further to 20.0% at a width of 7.
